summary: Gain +1 AC and advantage on Deception and Persuasion. Attacks improve while shapeshifted or disguised.

fields.Defence: Clothing, AC 10 plus Dexterity and the listed +1 AC bonus.
fields.Formless Slaughter: +1 to attack and damage rolls while shapeshifted or disguised.
fields.Faceless Masquerade: Advantage on Deception and Persuasion checks.
fields.Acquisition: Loot Orin’s remains at the Bhaal Temple.
fields.Base value: 800 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
